description: Stop tracking a shipment. Its history is kept and track_shipment with the same reference re-activates it. Only when the user asks to stop or remove a shipment. `shipment` (required) is the BerthTime id, the tracked reference, or a container number on the shipment. Returns: shipment_id, status (archived). Archiving an archived shipment changes nothing. Needs write access: a read + write API key, or read + write access granted at sign-in by an owner or admin of the company.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

shipment.description: BerthTime shipment id, or the tracked reference (container, bill of lading or booking number), or a container number on the shipment.

name: archive_shipment
title: Archive shipment
